text:
[About Me]
I'm M Faizan, an AI Engineer based in Islamabad, Pakistan. I graduated from IUIC Islamabad with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (BSCS).

I started my career in web development. My first role was as a Frontend Developer Intern at Mediatainment, and after that I worked as a MERN Stack Intern at Comrex Pvt Ltd, where I built full-stack web applications.

Today I work as an AI Engineer at Business Analytics, where I focus on building AI-powered solutions.

Outside of work, I love hiking and playing cricket.

My time at university gave me a strong foundation in programming, data structures, and problem-solving. It was during my degree that I first became curious about how software could do more than follow fixed rules, and that curiosity is what eventually pulled me toward artificial intelligence.
title: About Me

text:
[About Me]
Starting out in web development taught me a lot about building things people actually use. Working on frontends showed me how much a clean, simple interface matters, and working across the MERN stack taught me how the pieces of an application connect, from the database to the browser. Those lessons still shape how I build AI tools today, because a smart system is only useful if people can work with it easily.

Moving into AI felt like a natural next step. I enjoy the challenge of turning messy, real-world problems into working solutions, and I like that the field keeps changing, which means there's always something new to learn. I'm always trying to grow my skills and stay up to date with the latest tools and techniques.

When I'm not working, you'll usually find me outdoors. Hiking around the hills near Islamabad is my favorite way to clear my head, and cricket has been a part of my life for as long as I can remember, whether I'm playing with friends or following a match. I believe a good balance between work and the things I enjoy keeps me focused and motivated.
title: About Me

text:
[About Me]
My best friend is Bilal. Like me, he comes from Gujrat; his village is Thutha Rai Bahadar, and he belongs to the Raja family. From 2015 to 2022 he lived close to my home, so for seven years he was never more than a short walk away. Living so near each other meant we spent a huge part of our lives together, seeing each other almost every day, sharing ordinary moments that only became special when I looked back on them later. One of our favorite things to do together was going out on photo shoots, finding great spots and spending hours trying to capture awesome pictures. Those shoots were always full of laughter, experimenting with angles and ideas, and the photos we took are some of my best memories of our friendship. Over those years he became much more than a neighbor or a friend; he became someone I could talk to about anything, whether it was something serious on my mind or just a silly joke. Bilal is a genuinely good person: kind, honest, and dependable, the kind of friend who shows up when you need him without being asked. Having someone from the same roots as me made our bond even stronger, because we understood each other in a way that didn’t need much explaining.
title: About Me

text:

Life has moved us in different directions since then, and we don’t get to see each other as often as we used to, which is why I really miss him. Whenever someone asks me about the people who matter most in my life, Bilal is always one of the first names that comes to mind. If you want to connect with him call him at Instagram or facebook.

text:
[Opinions and Personality > My Views on AI]
I believe AI is one of the most important technologies of our time, and that its real value comes from solving practical problems for people and businesses, not from hype. I think systems like RAG are powerful because they ground AI answers in real information instead of guesswork. I also believe AI should be built responsibly: safe, honest about what it doesn't know, and protective of people's privacy. That's why I put effort into security layers that guard against things like prompt injection and leaking personal data.
